name: fabric-patterns
title: Fabric Patterns
description: Run Fabric AI patterns to analyze, summarize, extract insights, and transform text. Auto-detects input from selection, clipboard, or browser.
author: kimes

commands.name: run-pattern
commands.title: Run Fabric Pattern
commands.subtitle: Fabric
commands.description: Select a pattern and process input from clipboard, selection, or browser

preferences.name: fabricPath
preferences.title: Fabric Binary Path
preferences.description: Path to the fabric executable. Leave empty to auto-detect from PATH.

preferences.name: defaultModel
preferences.title: Default Model
preferences.description: AI model to use (e.g., gpt-4, claude-3-opus). Leave empty to use Fabric's default.

scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run build && echo '✅ Validation passed'
scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
